limitations: Unreported recognition is assigned the maximum 12 repetitions. Complexity is a predictor attached to chosen templates, not an isolated neural intervention. Stepwise fit and empirical PCA use these observations and do not supply held-out model validation.

The same 20 adults performed all parts in fixed order after passing sequence training in under 20 minutes; five of 25 recruits failed that criterion. Results concern this selected sample, not untrained learners or an independent replication cohort.

Sequence, primitive-pair and localizer blocks differ in timing and prior exposure. MEG sensor decoding is an observational readout within the task; it does not identify a necessary carrier, anatomical source, tensor binding or a complete nested program.

The paper reports no public raw-data deposit. Selected source-code reading is not a replay: decoder type, smoothing units, position indexing, trial-boundary handling and exclusions require reconciliation. Reported tests and fitted regressions remain publication results.

rationale.statement: In the selected adult sample, recognition repetitions, violation-response time and missed violations increase with assigned sequence complexity, including analyses excluding the irregular template. Published AIC selection also retains the presence of rotation by three steps for recognition and response time, and spatial distance for misses; description cost alone is not a complete behavioral account.

contexts.finding: Selected microglial or purinergic perturbations altered neural readouts, adenosine assays and seizure susceptibility. A1 agonist rescue depended on the genetic preparation.
limitations: Adult seizure cohorts have conflicting descriptions: Animals gives 8-16 weeks for pharmacological experiments, while Seizure Induction gives 14-20 weeks for all seizure experiments. No exact age is selected from this conflict. Genetic cohorts generally include both sexes; pharmacological seizure cohorts are male.

These are distinct genetic preparations. Cx3cr1-CreERT2 targets a lineage rather than proving absolute microglia specificity; P2ry12 deletion is whole-animal, and Drd1a-Cre ligand/receptor deletions are developmental. Cre-negative littermates are the stated default controls.

Neonatal P5-P7 cultures and adult in vivo preparations remain separate. Figure 4c is extracellular striatal dialysate under isoflurane; Figure 4h is a tissue-homogenate fluorescence assay after D1 agonist.

Cortical bouton imaging and striatal calcium imaging are different preparations. The cortical caption says intraperitoneal CNO/clopidogrel while its Methods says intravenous CNO. The neuronal-imaging virus volume and the A1-antagonist dose units also contain unresolved inconsistencies.

Cell and process counts do not replace independent mice. Calcium magnitude and rate-interaction nulls, receptor-specific rescue failures and challenge-specific nulls constrain generalization. Code, raw imaging and all supplementary datasets have not been independently replayed.
